item.title: Why is Assam's West Karbi Anglong Burning? Tensions Over Tribal Land Rights Turn Deadly
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam’s West Karbi Anglong district has been gripped by violent protests and bouts of anarchy over the past few days, with the primary reason being a long-standing land dispute between indigenous Karbi groups and non-tribal settlers, which erupted into large-scale confrontation at last. The unrest has claimed at least two lives, left dozens injured—including top police officials—and forced the state government to shut down internet services and impose strict curfews. item.description: GUWAHATI: Guwahati police have investigated an ATM battery theft reported from the Panjabari area, leading to the arrest of six persons and the recovery of stolen items from a scrap dumpyard in Birubari. The operation was conducted by a team from the Satgaon Police Station.
